docket_entries.description: THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE CASE SETTLED. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK:A. DATT NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE: CASE SETTLED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,000.00 FILED BY KUDINKIN, ALEXEY AS TO DEFENDANT JASPER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-10-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (NO SERVICE FEE INDICATED) SERVED APR-08-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT JASPER

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-10-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ALEXEY KUDINKIN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JASPER IS NOT PRESENT. COURT DETERMINES THAT THE CURRENT PROOF OF SERVICE IS NOT VALID. PLAINTIFF CLAIM WAS IMPROPER. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM WAS SERVED ON THE FRONT DESK ATTENDNAT AND STATES BY PERSONAL SERVICE. DEFENDANT IS A BUSINESS AND NEEDS TO BE SERVED ON THE AGENT OF SERVICE. CLERK PERFORMED A BUSINESS SEARCH ON THE SECRETARY OF STATES WEBSITE. INFORMATION RE: POSSIBLE AGENT OF SERVICE WAS PROVIDED TO PLAINTIFF. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. MATTER CONTINUED TO SEPTEMBER 10, 2021 AT 10:00 A.M. DEPT. 506.

DECLARATION CLARIFYING WHO DEFENDANT IS. PREVIOUSLY NAMED TO BE APARTMENT COMPLEX, "JASPER". IN THE MEANTIME REAL ENTITY(CORP)BEHIND IT IS "GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA INC" FILED BY PLAINTIFF KUDINKIN, ALEXEY
AMENDED MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,000.00 FILED BY KUDINKIN, ALEXEY AS TO DEFENDANT GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA INC
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.) FILED BY DEFENDANT GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA INC
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-15-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO NOV-18-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ALEXEY KUDINKIN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JASPER IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY PARKER JELLISON PROPERTY MANAGER. DEFENDANT GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA INC IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY PARKER JELLISON PROPERTY MANAGER. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1488 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE NOV 18TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
TRIAL RESET TO OCT-15-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF SEP-10-2021 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
